description.html: The orange-green artificial plant is a tall plant with thin, feathery leaves in orange and green tones. It is mounted on a light-colored base and stands on its own on the bottom.

Unlike live plants, an artificial one needs no lighting, fertilizer or trimming and does not change water quality. Even fish that usually destroy plants cannot eat it, and the dense leaves give cover to smaller fish and fry.

As a tall plant, it suits the back of the aquarium or the sides best. The fine leaves move gently in the water current, and the orange color contrasts nicely with green plants and a dark substrate. Maintenance is simple: every few weeks, or when you notice algae, rinse the plant with lukewarm water and go over it with a soft brush. Do not use detergents or cleaning products.
